# hermes_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages one HTTP/SSE MCP server registration in a Hermes profile. Stdio registrations remain outside this resource's host-process safety boundary.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable Hermes MCP server name. Names may contain letters, numbers, `.`, `_`, and `-`.
- `profile` (String) Lowercase Hermes profile that owns the MCP server. Use `default` explicitly when intended.
- `url` (String) HTTP or SSE MCP endpoint URL. Changing the endpoint replaces the registration.

### Optional

- `auth` (String) Hermes MCP authentication mode: `none`, `header`, or interactive `oauth`. `header` reads the bearer token from the environment variable named by `bearer_token_env` during create.
- `bearer_token_env` (String) Environment variable containing the bearer token used for header authentication. The token is read only during create and is never persisted in Terraform/OpenTofu state.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Hermes should use this MCP server. Toggling this preserves the registration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `transport` (String) Transport reported by Hermes; this resource always reports `http`.
